```bash
git clone https://github.com/nashiuso/nashiuso.git
cd nashiuso
pnpm install
```

```bash
pnpm dev        # dev server (Vite)
pnpm build      # production build - dist/
pnpm test       # unit tests (Vitest)
pnpm lint       # lint & format (Biome)
```
